notes: Show notes for a fee-only adviser's retirement income podcast episode, with one-sided private credit benefits, an undisclosed listener endorsement and a never-lost-money claim planted, and a fully disclosed third-party honor roll as the decoy.

planted.span: Anand explains why our Private Income Sleeve offers higher income than public bonds and less sensitivity to interest rates, because its loans carry floating rates that reset as market rates move.
planted.explanation: The income and interest-rate benefits of the private credit sleeve are presented with no treatment of its material risks (illiquidity and limited redemption, default and credit loss, and income that falls as the floating rates reset lower), unlike the balanced ladder, dividend and CD discussions in the same piece.

planted.span: Retired orthodontist Dr. Rosalind Glazebrook tells Celia why she has sent her sister, her neighbors and half of her former practice to Ullathorne Ormerod, and why she would do it again tomorrow.
planted.explanation: A personal recommendation of the firm is featured with no disclosure of whether Dr. Glazebrook is a client, whether she was compensated, or any material conflict.

planted.span: Ullathorne Ormerod clients have never lost money in a calendar year, a record no other firm in Virginia can match.
planted.explanation: An absolute no-loss claim across every client, paired with a comparative claim against every other Virginia firm, is a material statement of fact the adviser could not substantiate.

decoys.span: The Scawton Adviser Survey named Ullathorne Ormerod to its 2026 Honor Roll of Independent Wealth Advisers in Virginia, published May 19, 2026. Selection was based on data reported by participating firms for calendar year 2025, including client retention, staff credentials, assets under management and regulatory history. Ullathorne Ormerod paid the Scawton Adviser Survey a participation fee of $350 to be considered and paid nothing further to reference the recognition in its materials. The recognition is not indicative of future performance or of any client's experience.
decoys.why_ok: The recognition discloses the rater, the publication date (May 19, 2026), the period the honor roll was based on (calendar year 2025) and the compensation (a $350 participation fee to be considered and nothing further to reference it).
